attempts.reason:
Review of PR #190 (operator session, 2026-08-29). The switch (`dispatch.guards.path_overlap` off|running|unmerged, explicit > legacy `dispatch.path_guard` > `merge.mode`, `operator` treated like manual), the doctor line, the fake-gh tests for manual/auto/running, collision naming in the tick log and `--dry-run --json`, `.gitattributes` + `hkb init` (idempotent, keeps existing lines) with the union merge proven in a scratch repo, protocol.md and README — all sound; 838 tests, smoke green, clean on the tip.

**BLOCKER — the idle rule marks every live attempt idle after 60 s, so `running` and `unmerged` are dead modes.** `src/dispatch.js` ~554/~596-606: `lastSignal = a.heartbeat_at || a.started_at` comes from the run comment, and the default heartbeat is a ref-CAS (`src/lock.js` ~120: the ref's commit date is what the dispatcher reads back, and only when the attempt already looks older than `stale_after`). So between 60 s and 1 h, `lastSignal` is `started_at` and `attemptIdle` returns true even while the job record says `working` — the function checks `job && !jobAlive(job)` and then falls through to the stale timestamp instead of trusting a live job. Measured against the live board from the review worktree: #129 running, started 04:33:10, job aac9330e state "working", transcript mtime 0 s (692 KB, being written) → dry-run: "#129: attempt 1 idle since 04:33:10 — path_overlap will not hold its paths"; with the worktree's board.json set to `"running"`, `{"guarded":[],"claimed":[187,188,184]}` — all three overlap #129 and main guards them today. That breaks the contract ("do not remove `running`") and makes the `auto` default a no-op for bg attempts. The unit test enshrines it: `test/model.test.js` ~117 asserts `attemptIdle({ state: 'working' }, <1h-old>, 60) === true` under the label "a dead job turn"; the fake-gh idle test uses a pid attempt with `heartbeat_at: ago(300)`, a fixture the CAS heartbeat never produces.

Fix: when a job record exists, its liveness is the answer (`return !jobAlive(job)`); for the no-job clause use a signal that actually advances — the transcript mtime (`a.transcript_path` is on the row, one local `stat`) or the lock-ref beat — and use a threshold larger than one interval (the motivating #182 case was 40 minutes idle; a false "idle" under `running`/`unmerged` is exactly what those modes exist to prevent). Fix both tests to a fixture the real heartbeat produces (a bg attempt with a live job → holds; a bg attempt whose job turn ended → does not).

attempts.reason:
Second-pass review of PR #190 (operator session, 2026-08-29). The blocker is fixed for --bg attempts: `attemptIdle` now returns `!jobAlive(job)` whenever a job record exists (src/model.js ~336), the threshold is `max(interval, 600)`, the idle line logs once per attempt, the track-candidate path and the human --dry-run name the collision, AGENTS.md has the union note; 845 tests, smoke green, fast-forward on the tip. Live cross-check of real job records: working/blocked → holds, done → idle. Good.

**Still open — the no-job clause has no advancing signal** (src/dispatch.js ~553 `lastSignal = a.heartbeat_at || a.started_at`, ~595-603 the lock-beat read only past `stale_after`, ~613 the threshold). With the default `heartbeat: 'auto'` (ref-CAS, src/lifecycle.js ~125) the run comment's `heartbeat_at` is never written, so for every attempt without a job record — `claude-p`, `copilot-cli`, `codex` (process), `claude-action` (remote), `hkb claim` by hand (manual), any bg attempt on another host — `lastSignal` sits at `started_at` and the attempt is "idle" from minute 10 until reclaim. Probed on the branch (mode `running`, holder 30 min old): pid attempt with a LIVE pid, lock beat 30 s old and transcript written now → idle, #8 claimed; manual attempt with a 30 s lock beat → idle; remote attempt → idle; bg attempt with a live job on another host → idle. So `running`/`unmerged` are still dead modes for four of the six shipped profiles, and `test/dispatch.test.js` ~816 (pid attempt, `heartbeat_at: ago(700)` → idle) enshrines it with a fixture the ref-CAS heartbeat never produces.

Fix, cheap: (1) a live pid is authoritative the way a live job is — `if (a.pid && pidAlive(a.pid)) return false` before the timestamp clause; (2) for pidless no-job attempts (manual, remote, other-host bg) move the existing `lockBeatAt` read to fire past `idleThreshold` instead of only past `stale_after` — one commit read per such attempt per tick, only after 10 min — or `fs.statSync(a.transcript_path).mtime` when present (free); (3) threshold: a worker beating "every ~10 minutes" is idle on the tick before each beat at exactly the 600 s floor — use 2× the floor. Replace the ~816 test with the positive case: pid attempt, live pid, fresh lock beat → holds; and one for a manual attempt with a fresh lock beat → holds.

Also in the same pass: PR body still says collisions are named "in hkb doctor" (doctor prints the mode) and does not say #176 stays open as the `hkb show`/drawer half — say it (src/model.js ~305 says "folded into #185"; it is not); `docs/wiki/features/tracks.md` went stale (covers src/dispatch.js) and no page names `dispatch.guards.path_overlap` — add a short features page or a section on an existing one, re-stamp; src/board.js ~51 comment lost "and SubagentStop" in the merge (main added it in #187); stale "longer than one tick" wording at src/dispatch.js ~535 and src/model.js ~322/~330; `state.idle_logged` is never pruned (mirror the 24 h prune of `state.claims`) and `--dry-run` in the main checkout writes it, silencing the real loop's line.

Same branch, same PR (worktree-kb-185-1). Rerun lint/test/smoke, then `hkb finish`. The operator restarts the loop after this merges.

results.summary: path_overlap guard now takes dispatch.guards.path_overlap: "off"|"running"|"unmerged". Default follows merge.mode: "off" for manual (the default board), "unmerged" for auto (keys on running or review-with-open-PR, not just running). Legacy dispatch.path_guard boolean still works. Pure predicates live in src/model.js (pathOverlapGuard, pathHolders, pathCollisions, attemptIdle); src/dispatch.js wires attemptIdle into the reclaim pass so a running attempt with no bg-job progress or no heartbeat for over one tick interval never holds its paths in any mode. A guard hit names the colliding card and paths (summary.guarded[].collides_with, and the tick log). hkb doctor prints the effective mode and why (checkPathOverlapGuard). .gitattributes ships docs/wiki/log.md merge=union; hkb init writes the same line (ensureGitAttributes) and scripts/smoke-pack.mjs checks it. Docs: protocol.md (new path_overlap section + idle note in tick step 2), README.md (new path_overlap subsection under 'The last step'). PR #190 opened against main; rebased clean onto d102a4e.

results.summary: Fixed the reviewer's blocker: attemptIdle (src/model.js) now trusts a claude-bg attempt's job-record liveness unconditionally instead of falling through to a stale lastSignal — the default ref-CAS heartbeat never touches the run comment, so lastSignal sat at started_at for a bg attempt's whole life, making running/unmerged path_overlap guards no-ops between one tick and stale_after (the measured #129/#182 cases). The no-job fallback (manual/remote/pid attempts) now uses max(tick interval, 600s) instead of one tick, matching the heartbeat's own 10-minute floor. Also addressed the reviewer's should-fix list: the idle line now logs once per attempt (state.idle_logged, keyed by task/attempt, cleared once the attempt is alive again) instead of every tick; the track-candidate collision path now logs the same collision line the plain-card path already had; --dry-run's human summary in src/cli.js now appends 'collides with #N (paths)' to a guarded line; docs/wiki/AGENTS.md now notes the log.md merge=union line next to the log.md section. Left hkb show / the web drawer without collision naming, as the reviewer offered as an alternative — #176 stays open as that UI half; the tick's --dry-run and log output already name the collision, which was this card's actual 'Done when' requirement.

idle threshold heuristics (1200s floor, lock-beat refresh point) are judgment calls, not measured against a live board this pass

results.summary: Third-pass fix for the reviewer's remaining blocker: attemptIdle now trusts a live pid the same way it trusts a live job, and the pidless/jobless fallback (manual, remote, a claude-bg job on another host) refreshes its lock-ref beat at the (raised) idle threshold instead of only at stale_after, so it is no longer falsely called idle between the two. Idle threshold raised to max(interval, 1200) (2x the ~10min heartbeat floor). state.idle_logged is now pruned after 24h like state.claims, and a --dry-run tick no longer persists that dedup key (it was silencing the real loop's first idle line for an attempt it never actually watched go idle). Documented merge.mode: "operator" (#189) defaulting the guard to off like manual, in README and protocol.md. Added docs/wiki/features/path-overlap-guard.md (three modes, precedence, idle ladder) since no page named dispatch.guards.path_overlap; wiki.config.yml/index/log.md updated. hkb show/web drawer still do not name the collision inline (#176 stays open as that UI half — dry-run and the tick log already do). Merged origin/main (clean auto-merge) and pushed to PR #190's branch.
